policy_citations.section: SNF Level of Care - Definitions and Reference Guide › Definitions, Revenue codes 0191-0194
policy_citations.quote: Standard billing codes for the four SNF per-diem levels of care referenced in these guidelines: 0191 (skilled nursing), 0192 (rehabilitation therapy), 0193 (sub-acute), 0194 (weanable ventilator management).

system_note: Billed line: revenue code 0192 (Rehabilitation Therapy), 13 days, DOS 05/05/2026-05/22/2026. The facility's daily skilled-nursing progress notes (as supplied) document 14 days at Level 2 (0192) and 4 days at Level 1 (0191); the billed 13 Level-2 days therefore fall within the dates the facility itself documented as Level 2. The governing SNF reference defines a skilled need as a service requiring licensed nursing or therapy staff and identifies a "Non-covered day" as a day where documentation does not support the billed level of care (i.e., non-covered days are assessed per-day rather than denying the entire stay) (Policy: SNF Level of Care - Definitions and Reference Guide, Skilled need / Non-covered day) (ev_0002, pol_003). The record also contains a daily skilled nursing progress note for 05/09/2026 stating: Weekend Skilled Nursing Day: No therapy scheduled. Skilled nursing care per orders. Rev 0191, Level 1. (NOTE-SNF-medical-records-MR_SNF_05.pdf-n99) (pol_004) - this documents one of the Level-1 weekend days and explains absence of therapy on that date. The therapy-session schedule (get_daily_services) shows PT and OT sessions on the Level-2 days in the billed range (therapies present on weekdays; therapy absent on documented Level-1 weekend dates), which is consistent with the facility's own level documentation and the reference guide's criteria for skilled care. Because (a) the facility notes document 14 Level-2 days (more than the 13 billed), (b) the facility explicitly documents Level-1 on days without therapy (pol_004), and (c) the SNF reference supports assessing coverage per day (ev_0002, pol_003), the documentation as a whole supports the billed 13 days at revenue code 0192 for the DOS range given. Determination: No Finding. Evidence relied on: SNF level-of-care definitions (skilled need / non-covered day) and the facility's 05/09/2026 skilled nursing progress note documenting a Level-1 weekend day. If further payer-specific numeric minute thresholds are later provided (Aetna MA guideline, not present in the dataset), re-review may be warranted. Reviewed revenue line 2 (0191) billed 4 days within DOS range 2026-05-05 to 2026-05-22. Facility daily documentation establishes four Level 1 (0191) days (weekend skilled nursing days) and the record contains an explicit skilled-nursing-level statement for 05/09/2026: Weekend Skilled Nursing Day: No therapy scheduled. Skilled nursing care per orders. Rev 0191, Level 1 (ev_0002). The SNF Level-of-Care reference defines "Skilled need" as a service requiring licensed nursing or therapy staff (the basis for 0191 when therapy is not scheduled) (pol_003) and identifies 0191 as the skilled-nursing per-diem code (pol_004). Therapy session records (daily PT/OT entries) show therapy provided on multiple non-weekend dates and are absent on the documented weekend skilled nursing day (05/09), consistent with the facility's Level 1 designation for weekend days. Because the facility's clinical note documents skilled nursing need on the weekend day and the payer-agnostic reference supports Level 1 when therapy is not scheduled, the documentation supports the billed Level 1 per-diem for the four days billed as 0191. No adjustment to units or revenue code is indicated for this revenue line.
